text: Vael Academy rises beyond the gate: towers, courtyards, three banners, and more windows than Kai can count.

speaker: Kai
text: That’s a school?

speaker: Perrin
text: Some of it. You haven’t seen the part that looks like it’s trying to swallow the sky.

speaker: Kai
text: Please tell me that’s a joke.

speaker: Rina
text: It’s an exaggeration. Not a particularly large one.

speaker: Serra
text: The registry is straight ahead. We should sign in before the courtyard fills.
At the register, an official reads the next three names from a gilded ledger.

speaker: Registrar
text: Perrin of Emberwing. Serra of Tidemark. Rina of Thornrook.

speaker: Kai
text: Wait. Those are the names of the—

speaker: Perrin
text: The people who got their boots dirty with you? Those ones.

speaker: Kai
text: You could have mentioned it.

speaker: Perrin
text: Would it have helped?

speaker: Kai
text: I would’ve shouted a little more politely.

speaker: Serra
text: No, you wouldn’t.

speaker: Kai
text: No. Probably not.

speaker: Registrar
text: And ... Kai. Of Oakstead?
Behind them a few students exchange glances. A word—“commoner”—travels just far enough to be heard.

speaker: Kai
text: That’s me.

speaker: Serra
text: Then write it down. He is standing in front of you.
The registrar lowers the pen. A second line appears beneath Kai’s name: “House designation: pending.”

speaker: Rina
text: Pending. That is unusual.

speaker: Kai
text: It’s been an unusual week.

speaker: Perrin
text: Come on. There’s somewhere quieter to hear the invitation.
Inside the oath hall, three doors wait beneath three different banners. For the first time since leaving Oakstead, Kai is asked where he wishes to go.
